verification_report.summary: The proof is correct under the stated P14.2 all-point upper-semicontinuity assumption. Sequential checking validates the dominated monomial construction, its coherent-annihilator argument, approximation of finite and infinite ideal values, and the comparison corollary. The cited finite-energy bijection and normalized divisorial identity were located in Chapter 71, equations (71.39)-(71.40); the conditional preliminary corollary does not itself prove that interface. The MP definitions, divisorial finiteness, and comparison theorem match the primary text [MP24](https://arxiv.org/html/2409.06221v2). The finite-energy ray correspondence has the required Kähler scope [DXZ](https://arxiv.org/html/2302.02541v3). Xia's Definition 4.9 and Lemma 4.10 explicitly cover arbitrary decreasing nets with endpoints bounded below, and Lemma 4.2 supplies order reflection and injectivity for the full DXZ space [Xia](https://arxiv.org/html/2312.17150v3). Thus the model lifts decrease, their endpoints converge to the finite value phi(0), and their infimum has raw transform phi everywhere. Injectivity proves uniqueness and independence of the model net; divisorial comparison proves the pointwise order equivalence. The proof establishes precisely the claimed section and does not assert that every DXZ transform is MP-psh. No critical errors or gaps remain.
